newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Xinjiang trade $320 mln in first quarter.
newsitem.headline: China's Xinjiang trade $320 mln in first quarter.

text.p: China's northwestern Xinjiang region reported total foreign trade of $319.71 million in the first quarter, up 54.16 percent from the year-ago period, the International Business Daily said on Monday.
Of the total, general trade exports increased by 109.22 percent compared with the year-ago period, it said.

The newspaper attributed the increase in exports to growing exports of finished industrial products and high-value added goods as well as electronic and machinery products and small tractors, particularly through border trade, it said.
Finished industrial products now accounted for 60 percent of total exports, compared with a previous 40 percent, it said.
The region now had about 100 jointly invested projects with Chinese coastal provinces with total investment of 296 million yuan and production output value of 1.3 billion yuan, it said.
Total border trade from 1993 to 1996 accounted for half of total foreign trade of the region, it said.
Xinjiang has borders with Pakistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan and Russia.
